name: product
description: A money-gated lifecycle for taking consumer one-off / in-app-purchase products from idea to validated bet through launch and live-ops. Provides 10 stage playbooks (discovery, ideation, monetization design, validation, vertical-slice/MVP, production hardening, compliance, soft-launch, GTM launch, live-ops, and portfolio retrospective) plus a shared money-gate and unit-economics discipline, orchestrated by a coordinator and specialist, reviewer, and synthesizer agents that fan out, adversarially review, and synthesize each stage against net-of-fee economics.
